title: Show reviewers the value of a text block

cases.says: a block whose closing delimiter is aligned with its content loses its common indentation and keeps the nesting inside it
a block whose closing delimiter follows its last line gets the same treatment and no final line break
empty and whitespace-only lines leave the removed indentation unchanged and come out empty
a closing delimiter on its own line, left of the content, leaves the difference in front of every line
a closing delimiter on its own line, right of the content, removes no more than the content allows
whitespace at the end of a source line is not part of the value
a tab counts as one character of indentation, like a space, not as several columns

origin.section: A Tab and a Space Each Count as One Character
